note (classes: see delivery_framing.rs): admin UI capability editor: a held directory lock answers 409 with Retry-After through the shared refusal, no call delivery
admin UI write routes: the config gate's busy answer takes its 409 and Retry-After from the shared refusal, no call delivery
admin UI key create: reload off or an unloadable gateway.yaml answers 409 through the shared refusal, no call delivery
admin UI key create: the config gate refused the write while a restart is prepared, decided or stopping
admin UI key revoke: the config gate refused the write while a restart is prepared, decided or stopping
admin UI key revoke: the config writer's guarded read refused gateway.yaml, fixed text, no call delivery
admin UI writes (key create, key revoke, discovery adopt, settings save, backend and restore routes): a class of nothing attempted turns the route's own answer into 409, no call delivery
